chunks: Verily God knows what they invoke in His place, for He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of false gods?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Ankabut, this verse serves as a rhetorical refutation of polytheists who claim their idols possess independent power or intercession. Shia exegetes highlight that 'Al-Aziz' (The Mighty) underscores His ability to enforce His will, while 'Al-Hakim' (The Wise) indicates that His judgment regarding these false deities is perfectly measured, often noting that the idols themselves are powerless entities unable to even protect themselves.
